propositions: File-level git blame auto-derivation reproduced zero of eight independently proven bug origins, and produced one wrong-target result on the single case where it gave a confident answer

The deriver's fail-closed behaviour (50% abstention on 88-bug population; 7/8 on proven subsample) is working as intended, with abstentions concentrated in hard defect shapes (unmet obligations, carrier commits, omissions)
Recorded caused_by edges carry no provenance marker to distinguish blame-derived from explicitly supplied origins, making bulk accuracy unmeasurable despite having 88 instances
When a bug family is attributed to a single origin, per-file blame scatters the attribution across five different unrelated tickets, demonstrating the shape-dependency of auto-derivation confidence
The one confident wrong answer (moist-short-lionfish) matches the predicted failure mode: consumer-edited-last unmet obligation where the innocent producer ranked highest by blame

A derived vs explicit provenance marker on link events is necessary to make the metric's confidence computable, while shape-detection is not implementable since defect shape is not observable to the blame mechanism itself
